name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability to keep a tool call or full result; a rejected result is truncated when its call stays.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction and low-reduction results require a built-in summary.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Target character reduction. Below it, use the built-in summary only when estimated context usage remains at or above the compaction threshold.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated content head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters retained before the note when a tool result or old host notice is truncated; short content stays whole.

keepUnscored.title: Keep calls outside structured state
keepUnscored.description: Keep calls the fitted Jev state no longer shows in structured form instead of applying Jev's answer about them.
